angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,110,337 km at 321.84 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 3.1071 +/- 0.0154 mas (same row, RUWE 1.10): 321.84 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.596 +/- 0.06 solar radii from Torres et al. 2008, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HAT-P-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2008ApJ...677.1324T/abstract): 1,110,337 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.248 +/- 0.07 solar masses from Torres et al. 2008, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HAT-P-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2008ApJ...677.1324T/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5860 +/- 80 K from Torres et al. 2008, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2008ApJ...677.1324T/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Torres et al. 2008, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2008ApJ...677.1324T/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hat-p-4.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.128, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-4 (pscomppars): spectral type F, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+36 2593: main object type Em*, Emission-line Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-4 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.24 dex, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-4 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.431, from Torres et al. 2008 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2008ApJ...677.1324T/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-4 (pscomppars): age 3.9 Gyr, from Southworth 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011MNRAS.417.2166S/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-4 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 5.83 km/s, from Winn et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011AJ....141...63W/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
